digest.component_or_area: LLM gate run telemetry / usage logging
propositions: LLM gate runs compute loop-vs-breadth signal (distinct/total tool-call ratio) via failure_usage() but discard it at the write boundary, so operators cannot distinguish pathological loops from legitimate breadth without re-running

Local gate runs record nothing to disk when REBAR_USAGE_LOG is unset, requiring re-instrumented live runs to answer basic tuning questions despite the existing usage_log infrastructure being capable of recording them

The durable record omits wall-clock duration, ticket identifiers, request/tool-call limits, and per-run tool-call counts, making it impossible to correlate gate failures with budget exhaustion or to validate tuning advice already documented for operators

The success path never computes tool-call shape (distinct counts, repetition signatures) at all, recording only token aggregates while the failure path computes the full signal but throws it away one frame before the disk write

Wiring the existing failure_usage() reducer into both success and failure paths and adding explicit _SHAPE_FIELDS allowlist with gate-session default sink resolves the 'computed then discarded' defect without building parallel accounting machinery
